notes.title: 7-11-2025 Update
notes.notes:
* Updated the ESC (Escape) keyboard button functionality so that it brings up the Keyboard and Mouse Button Mapping Screen.

* Updated the Walk/Run Keyboard button so that it needs to be held for 1 second before switching to walking/running.

notes.title: June 30th 2025 Update
notes.notes: * Added the ability to turn off the in-game background music

notes.title: Significant Performance Update
notes.notes:
- REDUCED VRAM REQUIREMENTS BY 3-4 GB - Updated Isla's hair with a much more optimized version and changed the look. This performance optimization has made a significant improvement in VRAM usage. Vribyss Refuge™ The Escape is now playable with the GeForce 1060 GTX (6 GB) and the AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB).

- Fixed a "jittery movement" whenever the character moves backward or at an angle in "Strafing Mode."

- Fixed in-game camera moving way too fast.

notes.title: Update - 7-17-24
notes.notes:
• Switched the keyboard "Sword Equip/Unequip" key to "Y" for easier access.

• Added the ability to swing the sword with the "F" & "G" keyboard keys.

• Switched the keyboard "Strafing" key to "Tab" for easier access.

• Fixed a glitch where after the character dies she could "come back to life" for a few seconds before the game restarts.

notes.title: Update for 7-2-24
notes.notes:
• Increased the likeness of triggering the RMB combo attack. Fixed a glitch where it was hard to trigger this combo.

• Fixed a glitch that allowed the sword combo audio to continue playing if the character was injured or the attack was canceled by dashing away. Now all sword combo audio stops immediately if the combo is canceled for any reason.

• Updated the escape room so the game doesn't start from the beginning if the player falls off the cliff once and the game isn't saved. As long as the escape timer hasn't started, even if the player didn't save the game, they get one more chance before the game starts over from the beginning. 

• Updated the keyboard controls so that dashing fwd, bwd, left, & right can all happen with the keyboard alone. All menus were updated to reflect these changes.

notes.title: 6-25-24 - Small Update
notes.notes: * Upon request, the text that appears on the screen to show the player what button to press to save the game was made larger.

notes.title: Update for June 14th
notes.notes:
* Made changes to the level so that it's more clear where to go and what to do next.

* Added better lighting in certain areas where it should be easier to see what's happening. 

* Updated the mouse XY 2D axis so the camera points up when the mouse wheel is scrolled upwards and vice versa.

* Created an option in the pause menu for players to decide which up/down camera direction they prefer during gameplay.

* Smoothed out the in-game camera movement so it moves at the same speed whether the player is using a keyboard and mouse or a PS5 Dualsense controller.

* Fixed a glitch where two audio tracks can play simultaneously in a certain area.

* Updated the main menu so the "Continue" button doesn't appear if the game has never been saved.

* Fixed a glitch where on a rare occasion the character isn't able to swing the sword intermittently while fighting enemies.

* Fixed a glitch where on a rare occasion while the character is fighting an enemy, the sword charge bar can get stuck on the screen permanently.

* Updated the alternate ending to create more of a unique experience. 

* Updated the downloadable strategy guide to reflect all the changes.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
* Some bugs were fixed to clarify the players' mission in the game in various areas.

* Fixed some bugs where the character would not be able to move in certain parts of the game for no apparent reason.

* Fixed camera clipping issues in the beginning area.
